intro: Baby Spinach at CAVA offers a nutrient-dense, low-calorie base option for building your perfect Mediterranean bowl or pita. With just 20 calories and 3 grams of protein, these tender baby spinach leaves provide a fresh, wholesome foundation that complements the entire [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases). This leafy green base is included with every order at no extra cost.
priceCalories: Baby Spinach is included in your CAVA bowl or pita at no additional charge, making it an excellent value choice. At only 20 calories per serving, it is the lowest-calorie base option on the [full CAVA menu](/). With 3g protein, 3g carbs, and 0g fat, it provides essential nutrients without adding significant calories to your meal.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Baby Spinach apart is its incredibly low calorie count combined with high nutritional value. The tender, young spinach leaves are carefully selected for their mild flavor and soft texture. Unlike mature spinach, baby spinach does not have a bitter taste, making it an ideal base that does not overpower other ingredients in your [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) selections.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Baby Spinach contains 20 calories, 3g protein, 3g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. This nutritional profile makes it perfect for low-calorie, high-protein meal planning. Baby Spinach is naturally rich in vitamins A, C, and K, plus iron and folate. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete meal macros when building custom bowls.
whatsInside: Baby Spinach at CAVA contains only one simple ingredient: tender baby spinach leaves. There are no additives, preservatives, or dressings pre-applied to the greens. The spinach is sourced fresh and kept refrigerated to maintain optimal crispness and nutritional value. This single-ingredient simplicity makes it suitable for virtually all dietary preferences and restrictions, including [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) options.
tasteLike: Baby Spinach offers a mild, slightly sweet flavor with a tender, delicate texture. Unlike mature spinach, it lacks bitterness and has a more subtle earthy taste. The soft leaves provide a fresh, clean base that allows other ingredients from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) and [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) to shine through while adding nutritious volume to your bowl.
customize: Customize your Baby Spinach base by pairing it with grilled proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like chicken, lamb, or falafel. Layer on vibrant toppings such as tomatoes, cucumbers, and pickled onions. Add creamy options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like hummus or tzatziki. Finish with a flavorful dressing to create your perfect personalized Mediterranean bowl experience.
pairsWell: Baby Spinach pairs exceptionally well with Brown Rice (310 cal), creating a nutrient-rich double base option. It complements creamy dips like hummus and tzatziki, which add richness to the mild greens. Grilled chicken or lamb mains provide protein contrast, while tangy dressings like lemon herb vinaigrette enhance the spinach's subtle flavor. Roasted vegetables and feta cheese also make excellent accompaniments.
healthyChoice: Baby Spinach is one of the healthiest base choices at CAVA, offering maximum nutrition with minimal calories. At just 20 calories, it allows you to enjoy a larger portion while keeping your meal light. The 3g of protein supports muscle maintenance, while the zero fat content makes it ideal for low-fat diets. Rich in antioxidants and vitamins, it supports overall wellness and weight management goals.
howToOrder: To order Baby Spinach at CAVA, start by choosing your bowl or pita format. Select Baby Spinach as your base when building your order in-store or online. You can combine it with another base like Super Greens (35 cal) or Black Lentils (270 cal) for added variety. Then proceed to select your main protein, dips, toppings, and dressing to complete your customized Mediterranean creation.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Saffron Basmati Rice (290 cal) and Brown Rice (310 cal), Baby Spinach offers significantly fewer calories while providing more micronutrients. Super Greens (35 cal) is the closest alternative with similarly low calories but different greens. Black Lentils (270 cal) provide more protein and fiber but substantially more calories. Baby Spinach is ideal for those prioritizing low-calorie, nutrient-dense meal foundations.
whoShouldTry: Baby Spinach is perfect for health-conscious diners seeking low-calorie meal options without sacrificing nutrition or flavor. Weight management enthusiasts will appreciate its minimal calorie impact. Those following keto, paleo, or low-carb diets benefit from its macronutrient profile. Anyone looking to increase vegetable intake or build lighter, fresher Mediterranean bowls should definitely choose this wholesome base option.
worthTrying: Baby Spinach is absolutely worth trying as your CAVA base, especially if you want to maximize nutrition while minimizing calories. Its inclusion at no extra cost provides exceptional value. The mild flavor works with virtually any combination of proteins, dips, and dressings. Whether you are health-focused or simply prefer lighter meals, Baby Spinach delivers freshness and nutrition in every bite.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Baby Spinach?
faqs.a: CAVA Baby Spinach contains only 20 calories per serving, making it the lowest-calorie base option available. It also provides 3g protein, 3g carbs, and 0g fat.

faqs.q: Is Baby Spinach at CAVA free?
faqs.a: Yes, Baby Spinach is included with your CAVA bowl or pita at no additional charge, just like all other base options on the menu.

faqs.q: Can I get double Baby Spinach at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, you can choose Baby Spinach as a double base or combine it with another base option like Super Greens or Brown Rice to create your ideal bowl foundation.
Yes, Baby Spinach is naturally gluten-free and safe for those with gluten sensitivities or celiac disease. It contains only fresh baby spinach leaves with no additives.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Baby Spinach and Super Greens at CAVA?
faqs.a: Baby Spinach contains only tender spinach leaves (20 cal), while Super Greens is a blend of different leafy greens (35 cal). Both are low-calorie, nutrient-dense base options.
